system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Global Fire Atlas: Day of Burn (2003-2016)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Global 500 m raster layers recording the day of year on which each burned pixel was detected from 2003 through 2016.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Annual images from 2003 through 2016; each image encodes within-year burn timing as day-of-year pixel values.
data_description.temporal_unit: Annual image with day-of-year pixel values
data_description.data_type_numeric: Integer values representing day of year when burning occurred

bands.name: b1
bands.description: Day of burn - Julian day (1-365/366) when the pixel was detected as burned

data_description.important_note: The collection is annual, not a daily image series. Daily timing is encoded in each pixel as its day of burn within that year. This asset contains only the Day of Burn layer; fire direction, fire line, fire speed, ignition, and perimeter products are separate assets.
analytical_capabilities: Fire progression timing analysis from day-of-year gradients
Combination with climate data for fire risk assessment

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Day of year (Julian day, 1-365 or 1-366 for leap years) when burning was detected at each pixel location.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Select the annual image first, then interpret `b1` as day of year. Do not treat collection images as daily observations. Separate Global Fire Atlas assets are required for direction, line length, speed, ignition, or perimeter variables.

data_description.data_source: Global Fire Atlas by Niels Andela via Google Earth Engine Community Catalog
